Prehensile_Ovipositor_Stinger.description: A highly modified ovipositor extending from the abdomen. Instead of laying eggs, it functions as a highly maneuverable, retractable hypodermic needle connected directly to an agonizing venom sac.

Cerci_Sensory_Appendages.description: A pair of highly sensitive, antenna-like structures protruding from the rear of the abdomen. They detect the minutest shifts in air pressure from behind, granting near-precognitive reaction times against ambush.
